relations.subject: DJUVERNUA, Aleksandr Lvovič
relations.evidence: studied from 1855 law and history at Moscow University, but gradually switched to philology. Beside Slavic he was specially interested in Lithuanian, but also learned Sanskrit and Arabic. Student of Petrov. Graduated 1866

relations.subject: DJUVERNUA, Aleksandr Lvovič
relations.evidence: From 18?? until death Professor of Comparative Linguistics at Moscow
